checks.text: The page heading reads "Income Tax Calculator" and the result summary shows "Tax: $0.00", "Effective rate: 0.00%", and "Taxable income: $0.00".

Typing 50000 in the field labelled "Gross income", selecting "Single" in the select labelled "Filing status", and clicking "Calculate" shows "Tax: $4,600.00", "Effective rate: 9.20%", and "Taxable income: $40,000.00".

Typing 100000 in the field labelled "Gross income", selecting "Single" in the select labelled "Filing status", and clicking "Calculate" shows "Tax: $15,600.00", "Effective rate: 15.60%", and "Taxable income: $90,000.00".

Typing 50000 in the field labelled "Gross income", selecting "Married filing jointly" in the select labelled "Filing status", and clicking "Calculate" shows "Tax: $4,400.00", "Effective rate: 8.80%", and "Taxable income: $40,000.00".

Typing 200000 in the field labelled "Gross income", selecting "Single" in the select labelled "Filing status", and clicking "Calculate" shows "Tax: $41,200.00", "Effective rate: 20.60%", and "Taxable income: $190,000.00".

After calculating with Gross income 50000 and Filing status "Single", the breakdown table contains a row with "10%", "$10,000.00" taxed and "$1,000.00" tax, and a row with "12%", "$30,000.00" taxed and "$3,600.00" tax.
Clicking the button "Copy result" after calculating 50000 Single copies the text "Tax: $4,600.00" to the clipboard.
Typing 0 in the field labelled "Gross income" and clicking "Calculate" shows the message "Enter a gross income greater than 0" and the result summary remains "Tax: $0.00".
Reload keeps the last calculation: after calculating with Gross income 50000 and Filing status "Single", reloading the page still shows "Tax: $4,600.00" and "Effective rate: 9.20%".
